dedupe_keys.name: geoscience australia gnss data centre cors rinex files station metadata and real time streams

description: The Geoscience Australia GNSS Data Centre is the national repository for data from Continuously Operating Reference Stations (CORS) that contribute to the Asia-Pacific Reference Frame, and publishes observation files, station metadata and GNSS products through documented interfaces. Coverage: Australia and contributing CORS networks in the Asia-Pacific region; RINEX observation and navigation files as daily 24-hour files at 30-second sampling from all stations, hourly files at 30 seconds and 15-minute high-rate observation files at 1 second from a subset, all gzip compressed and Hatanaka compressed for observations; current and historical site metadata on ownership, location and equipment for every station; real-time CORS data in RTCM 3 through the AUSCORS NTRIP broadcaster. Format and access: anonymous download by SFTP (sftp.data.gnss.ga.gov.au), an S3 bucket (ga-gnss-data-rinex-v1) with a browse page, a RINEX File Query web API returning JSON download links, GeodesyML site logs through a metadata API, and the GNSS Site Manager web app; free for open stations. Licence: the documentation site links Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia in its footer; a licence statement for the data files was not read. Caveats: most data are open, but some stations are closed and need authenticated access requested from GA; the query API can also return files that have not passed metadata quality checks; the number of stations was not read. Simulation uses: positioning reference data for testing GNSS outage and space weather effects on timing and navigation dependent infrastructure. Related records: GA's Ginan precise positioning toolkit (model-ginan) and the AUSPOS online processing service (platform-auspos) use these observations.
